definitions: A district in the city of Kaifeng, Henan province, China.
A town in the county of Wuyuan, Jiangxi province, China.
A town in the county of Linli, Hunan province, China.
A historical figure, the elder of the two Qiao sisters, known for her beauty and marriage to Sun Ce during the late Eastern Han dynasty of China.
examples: The administrative center of Daqiao District is bustling.
Daqiao is a significant agricultural hub in Wuyuan.
She studied the history of Daqiao.
